blocker_summary: review:code_quality:warning:e2e/runner.go:0 — Hardcoded absolute paths `/Users/dabrams/gromit` and `/tmp/gromit-fixtures` make the e2e suite non-portable; it cannot run in CI or on any other machine. (suggested fix: Read paths from environment variables (`GROMIT_REPO_ROOT`, `GROMIT_FIXTURE_BASE`) with documented defaults, and set them in the test helper or a Makefile target.)
replan_context: review:spec_alignment:error:calc/calc_test.go:0 — No tests for Subtract are present in the diff. The spec requires tests in calc/calc_test.go covering AC1 (Subtract(5,3)==2), AC2 (Subtract(0,0)==0), and AC3 (Subtract(3,5)==-2). (suggested fix: Add table-driven or individual test cases for Subtract covering the three acceptance criteria.)

review:spec_alignment:error:internal/next/specloop/stages/evidence.go:60 — effectiveStatus still checks `allDone && gates` before returning ready_for_review, but FinalizeStage was updated in this same diff to check only the three gate booleans (removing the allDone check). A run with a failed task from an earlier cycle that passes all three gates will be labeled ready_for_review by FinalizeStage but needs_human in summary.md and review.md written by EvidenceStage. (suggested fix: Remove the allDone check from effectiveStatus so it mirrors FinalizeStage: `if rs.FinalValidationPassed && rs.FinalReviewPassed && rs.FinalAcceptancePassed { return runstore.StatusReadyForReview }`.)

review:spec_alignment:warning:internal/next/specloop/taskloop.go:218 — The structural *_test.go coverage check (iterate ExpectedTouchedArea, match _test.go suffix, downgrade ir.Pass) is copy-pasted in both the initial inspect path and the repair retry path. Any future logic change must be applied in both places. (suggested fix: Extract the check into a helper function e.g. `applyTestFileCoverageCheck(ir InspectResult, task runstore.Task, filesChanged []string) InspectResult` and call it from both paths.)

review:spec_alignment:warning:internal/next/specloop/stages/plan.go:240 — filterForbiddenFixTasks detects the test-file constraint by scanning for natural-language substrings ("test file", "do not modify", "must not be modified", "not modify"). Differently phrased constraints are silently missed; task objectives containing those words could produce false positives. (suggested fix: Consider a more structured approach: parse Out-of-Scope bullet points into a list of file glob patterns during compile stage and store them as structured data rather than raw text.)

review:spec_alignment:warning:internal/next/specloop/taskloop.go:347 — maxTaskIDInQueue in taskloop.go (operates on []taskEntry, returns int) and maxTaskID in plan.go (operates on []runstore.Task, returns string) are near-identical functions. Any change to the "t-NNN" ID format must be applied in both places. (suggested fix: Consolidate into a single shared helper in the specloop package that both callers use.)

review:code_quality:error:calc/calc.go:0 — The `Subtract(a, b int) int` function is absent from the diff. This is the primary in-scope deliverable required by all three acceptance criteria (AC1–AC3). The file appears as `?? calc/` (untracked) in git status, but no changes to calc/calc.go appear anywhere in the diff and spec compliance cannot be verified. (suggested fix: Add `func Subtract(a, b int) int { return a - b }` to calc/calc.go and commit the file so it appears in the diff.)

review:code_quality:error:calc/calc_test.go:0 — No tests for Subtract are present in the diff. The spec explicitly requires tests in calc/calc_test.go covering AC1 (Subtract(5,3)==2), AC2 (Subtract(0,0)==0), and AC3 (Subtract(3,5)==-2). (suggested fix: Add table-driven or individual test cases for the three acceptance criteria to calc/calc_test.go and commit the file.)

review:code_quality:error:internal/next/specloop/stages/evidence.go:60 — `effectiveStatus` checks `allDone && gates` before returning `ready_for_review`, but `FinalizeStage` (updated in this same diff) checks only the three gate booleans. A run with a failed task from an earlier fix cycle that passes all three gates will be labeled `ready_for_review` by FinalizeStage but `needs_human` in summary.md and review.md written by EvidenceStage. (suggested fix: Remove the `allDone` check from `effectiveStatus` to match FinalizeStage: `if rs.FinalValidationPassed && rs.FinalReviewPassed && rs.FinalAcceptancePassed { return runstore.StatusReadyForReview }`)

review:code_quality:warning:CONTINUE.md:0 — The diff contains 1500+ lines of changes to CONTINUE.md, cmd/gromit-next/, internal/next/, contracts/, e2e/, and docs/ — none of which are in-scope for this spec. The Architectural Constraint states all code must stay in the `calc` package. (suggested fix: No action for this spec. These changes belong to a separate branch or commit that should not be bundled with the add-subtract spec implementation.)

review:code_quality:warning:internal/next/specloop/taskloop.go:218 — The structural `*_test.go` coverage check (iterate `ExpectedTouchedArea`, match `_test.go` suffix, downgrade `ir.Pass`) is copy-pasted in two places: the initial inspect path and the repair retry path. Any future logic change must be applied in both places. (suggested fix: Extract to a helper: `func structuralTestFileCoverage(ir InspectResult, task runstore.Task, filesChanged []string) InspectResult` and call it from both paths.)

review:code_quality:warning:internal/next/runstore/types.go:112 — `runstore.InvocationRecord` and `evidence.InvocationRecord` are duplicate struct definitions with identical fields. Every new field (e.g. `Provider` added in this diff) requires manual updates in both structs and a corresponding line in the field-by-field conversion loop in evidence.go. (suggested fix: Use `runstore.InvocationRecord` as the canonical type in the evidence bundle, importing it from runstore. The import-cycle concern that motivated duplication can be resolved by moving `evidence.InvocationRecord` into runstore (as was done for this struct) and deleting the duplicate.)

review:code_quality:warning:internal/next/specloop/stages/plan.go:240 — `filterForbiddenFixTasks` detects the test-file constraint by scanning for natural-language substrings ("test file" + "do not modify" / "must not be modified" / "not modify"). Differently phrased constraints are silently missed; task objectives containing those words could produce false positives. (suggested fix: Encode the constraint detection as a typed flag on `RunState` (e.g. `ForbidTestFileModification bool`) set during compile from a structured spec field, and key the filter off that flag rather than substring matching.)

review:code_quality:warning:internal/next/specloop/taskloop.go:347 — `maxTaskIDInQueue` (taskloop.go, operates on `[]taskEntry`, returns `int`) and `maxTaskID` (plan.go, operates on `[]runstore.Task`, returns `string`) are near-identical functions. Any change to the `t-NNN` ID format must be applied in both places. (suggested fix: Consolidate into a single package-level helper `parseTaskIDNum(id string) (int, bool)` in a shared file (e.g. taskid.go) and use it from both call sites.)

review:code_quality:warning:e2e/runner.go:0 — Hardcoded absolute paths `/Users/dabrams/gromit` and `/tmp/gromit-fixtures` make the e2e suite non-portable; it cannot run in CI or on any other machine.
